review.evidenceBasis: Title-only posture, tightened rule. 20 spec-level rejects: A-level-only clauses carried by GCSE videos (acyl chlorides, pH calculations, Q=It, Kp, pH curves, condensation repeat units), wrong-topic hits (Group-2 video bound to Period-3 spec), and benzene videos bound to phenol/phenylamine clauses.

rejects.reason: GCSE 'Covalent Bonding 1' covers H2/Cl2/HCl; the expanded-octet examples (SO2, PCl5, SF6) of 3.4.2 are A-level-only, not title-evidenced.
F=Le relation between the Faraday and Avogadro constants (24.1.2) is electrochemistry, not title-evidenced in an Avogadro-constant calculations video.
'How to Determine the Standard Enthalpy Change of Reaction' — lattice energy / atomisation enthalpies (23.1.1) are a distinct topic, not title-evidenced.
Same video: energy cycles combining lattice energy and enthalpy change of solution (23.2.2) not title-evidenced.
'Redox Reactions of Group 2 Elements…' bound to a Period-3 clause (9.2.1: Na, Mg, Al reactions) — wrong group; topic mismatch.
GCSE 'Combustion of Hydrocarbons' names the reaction; the environmental-consequences clause (CO, NOx, unburnt hydrocarbons) of 14.1.6 is not title-evidenced.
'Directing Groups in the Reactions of Benzene' — halogenoarene production routes (31.1.1) not title-evidenced.
GCSE 'Limitations of Bonding Diagrams' is about the limits of dot-and-cross; the construct-ionic-covalent-coordinate-diagrams clause of 3.7.1 is not title-evidenced.
'Nitration of Benzene' — the phenol-vs-benzene conditions comparison of 32.2.5 is a distinct clause, not title-evidenced.
Same video: phenylamine preparation via nitration-then-reduction (34.2.1) not title-evidenced.
'Bromination of Benzene' — phenol bromination comparison (32.2.5) not title-evidenced.
'The Reactions of Phenol' — the phenol production route from diazonium salts (32.2.1) is a preparation clause, not title-evidenced.
GCSE 'Carboxylic Acids' — relative acidities of carboxylic acids/phenols/alcohols (33.1.4) is A-level-only, not title-evidenced.
Same video: PCl3/PCl5/SOCl2 conversion to acyl chlorides (33.1.2) not title-evidenced at GCSE.
'The Equilibrium Constant Kc' — the Kp (partial-pressure) calculations of 7.1.7 are a distinct CIE topic, not title-evidenced.
'How to Carry Out a Titration' is technique-level; the pH-curve sketching of 7.2.9 is the distinctive content, not title-evidenced.
GCSE 'Strong and Weak Acids' — [H+] and pH calculation clause of 25.1.4 not title-evidenced.
GCSE RP3 Electrolysis — Q=It charge/mass/volume calculations of 24.1.3 not title-evidenced.
GCSE Biology 'The Nitrogen Cycle' bound to a chemistry clause (N2 triple-bond inertness, 12.1.1) — cross-subject keyword hit.
Cognito 'What is a Polymer?' is addition-polymer level; the condensation repeat-unit deduction of 35.1.3 is not title-evidenced.
